why.heading: Why AICC picked these
why.recoIntro: Reco is your guide inside AICC. Here it explains each choice.
why.none: Tick a product to see why AICC lists it for the pour-over set.
why.filters: In this sample store's orders, paper filters appear with the pour-over set more often than anything else, and they are used up with every brew.
why.grinder: A hand grinder was bought together fewer times than the filters: shoppers setting up a pour-over routine often add one, but not every time.
why.kettle: A kettle was bought together less often still, so AICC lists it after the products above.
why.mug: There is no purchase history for this pair yet, so this spot is filled from the same category. As orders come in, real co-purchases take over.
why.without: Plain related products come from the same category, which is how WooCommerce related products work by default. Nothing about them comes from what your shoppers buy together.
why.merchant: This is the evidence behind the list: how many times each product was bought together with the pour-over set, and which spots are filled from the same category.

reco.intro: Reco: tick a product and I'll tell you why it is in the list.
reco.filters: Reco: paper filters were bought together with the pour-over set most often, so they come first.
reco.grinder: Reco: a grinder was bought together fewer times than the filters, so it comes next.
reco.kettle: Reco: a kettle was bought together less often, so it is listed after the others.
reco.mug: Reco: no purchase history for this pair yet, so this is a same-category fallback.
reco.without: Reco: plain related products come from the category, not from orders.

help.none: Choose a product and a rule. Choosing the same rule again removes it.
help.pin: Keep this product near the top.
help.prefer: Give this product a little extra priority.
help.deprioritize: Lower this product's priority without removing it outright.

effect.pin: Pinned: it moves to the first place.
effect.exclude: Excluded: it is removed from the list. Exclude always wins.
effect.prefer: Preferred: it moves up one place.
effect.deprioritize: Deprioritized: it moves down one place.
effect.stays: No move this time: prefer and deprioritize nudge one place, never across groups, and not past a product with the same kind of rule.
effect.outOfStock: Out-of-stock products stay out, even when pinned.

rules.announceReset: All rules removed. The list is back to AICC's own order.

ru.fbtLead: WooCommerce can tell which products share a category. AICC adds the signal merchants usually have to guess at: which products customers actually buy together, with sensible fallbacks where history is thin.
